messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: I want to analyze 1-1-1 Multilevel Model with lavaan.survey.
parts:
Dear all.

I want to know demographic characteristics are working moderator variables like in meta-analysis moderation analysis; fisher's Z or % Variance due to sampling error. So, I want to analyze 1-1-1 multilevel model with the lavaan.survey variables; without level 2 variables like team climate, interpersonal dependencies, etc.

All measures are observed individual level, so I just want to check the effects of demographic characteristics like sex, cohorts of age, marriage status, job status (e.g. Freelancer, board member of the Firm, full time job, part time job, student, etc.), education level, etc.; all variables are categorical variables. I just expect a simple result like R-square coefficient on analysis of dummy variables in OLS Regression.

Overall, I can summarize my question to two.
  1. Can I estimate to know moderation effects of demographic variables? (All measures are observed individual level; not level 2)
  2. After checking the 1, Can I correction effects of demographic variables to my full SEM model?
I love lavaan. So I hope this analysis can solve on lavaan and lavaan.survey packages.


Seongho.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: I want to analyze 1-1-1 Multilevel Model with lavaan.survey.
parts:
On 12/09/2013 09:14 PM, Davide Morselli wrote:
> Hi Yves, Could you give a few more hints on how to do multileve SEM
> in lavaan. i thought this feature was still under development and not
> implemented yet.

I'm not sure what your question is. Some hints nonetheless:

- if your data is balanced (eg the same number of repeated measures for
very observation), you can uses these repeated measures as indicators of
latent variables with fixed factor loadings, just like in a growth curve
analysis

- if your data is unbalanced, but all you need is to 'control' for the
cluster effect, and all your variables are at the case-level, you can
you the lavaan.survey package.

Yves.
